findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security header
findings.details: Without HSTS, browsers may continue to use insecure transport for future visits.
findings.recommendation: Add a Strict-Transport-Security header after validating that HTTPS is correctly enforced.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.details: A missing CSP reduces protection against script injection and unsafe third-party content.
findings.recommendation: Define a baseline Content-Security-Policy that limits script, frame, and object sources.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.details: This makes it easier for other sites to embed the page in an iframe.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Frame-Options or an equivalent frame-ancestors CSP directive.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.details: Browsers may try to MIME-sniff content when this header is absent.
findings.recommendation: Return X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff for public responses.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
findings.details: The browser may leak more referrer information than intended on cross-site navigation.
findings.recommendation: Set a Referrer-Policy such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Missing Cache-Control header
findings.details: No cache directive was detected on the homepage response.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit Cache-Control directives so browsers and edge caches know how to treat the response.

findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.details: No meta description was found in the fetched homepage HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add a concise meta description to improve how the page is summarized externally.
